method: Reviewed OSM carriageway graph, city-listed monitored direction, named cross streets and city certificates for naming ambiguities. Existing OSM vertices are followed; only bounded-area endpoints may be interpolated along their actual road edge. Area extents are an app policy, not camera coordinates or official enforcement boundaries.
